resources.string: A cat who lives on your home screen. Each time you come back to it she does something new, and from 23:00 to 07:00 she sleeps.
If that does not open, long-press the home screen and choose Wallpapers, then Live wallpapers, then Lili.
Lili picture from %1$s, no longer updated
Not available. Android doesn’t let apps animate the lock screen. On stock Android (Pixel, Motorola…), turn on Home screen and choose “Home screen and lock screen” in the picker.
Choose “Home screen and lock screen” to have her on the lock screen too, on phones that allow it (stock Android). Huawei, Samsung, Xiaomi and Oppo show her on the home screen only.
Choose “Home screen” on the next screen.
Choose “Home screen and lock screen” on the next screen.
Android doesn’t let Lili read your current wallpaper, so she can’t save it. When you turn her off, you can choose a photo or the system default instead.

Huawei: if her picture does not show on the lock screen, turn off Magazine unlock. For updates every few hours, let Lili run in the background (Battery, App launch, Manage manually).
